_README: Cost figures for memory systems as REPORTED by their own papers or by
third-party comparisons. Nothing here was measured by this repo.
Two cautions that must survive into any plot or table:
1. These were measured on different benchmarks (mostly LoCoMo), not on
LongMemEval, so they are NOT directly comparable to our measured
numbers. Plot them on separate axes or label them explicitly.
2. Every entry below was taken from a paper abstract, table snippet, or
secondary comparison, not from a full read of the source. Each has
verified=false until someone opens the paper and confirms it.
`verified` MUST be flipped to true only by a human who has read the cited
source. Do not plot unverified numbers in a final artifact.

systems.source: Mem0 paper (arXiv 2504.19413) for read tokens + score; write token total as reported in RecMem's comparison table (arXiv 2605.16045)
